verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents enterprise SSO that works with any SAML or OIDC IdP. Organizations and SSO connections are managed together, and Auth0 imports bring users, organizations and enterprise SSO connections across, which supports per-customer SSO connections. Community users confirm the SAML setup wizard works well, and SCIM Directory Sync covers provisioning, but nothing in the pack mentions domain verification or just-in-time provisioning at SSO login. Missing for 10: evidence of verified domains per organization, evidence of just-in-time user provisioning on SSO sign-in, explicit docs tying each SSO connection to a single organization.
